focus_areas: Stitch integrity: Ensure individual stitches are distinct and do not merge into each other or the leather.
Leather grain: Verify the pore structure is natural and non-repetitive.
Geometric consistency: Check that the curve of the seam matches the spherical projection.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the red thread and the white leather. AI models often struggle with the 'hole' aspect of the stitching, sometimes rendering the thread as sitting on top without displacement or causing the leather edges around the holes to melt. Also, verify if the stitch spacing is physically consistent; irregular spacing can be a sign of generation error.
